description: A two-channel meter that reads a voltage as volts, as a note name, as MIDI numbers and as a tempo, and counts the samples between events on its two inputs

params.text: Chooses how the A input is read: as a level to be measured, or as a clock whose pulses are timed
Chooses how the B input is read: as a level to be measured, or as a clock whose pulses are timed
Clears the readings and the tempo averages
Holds every reading where it is, so a passing value can be read off

inputs.text: The first voltage to be measured, or the first clock to be timed
The second voltage to be measured, or the second clock to be timed
A trigger here clears the readings and the tempo averages
A trigger here holds every reading where it is, and another releases it

notes: nothing is sent out of this module; it has no output jacks and only reports what arrives at A and B.
the DELAY reading counts the samples between the event on A and the event on B, which is how a one-sample cable delay can be measured.
in CV mode the tempo reading follows Rack's convention of 120 BPM at 0V doubling every volt, capped at 999; in Trig mode it is worked out from the time between pulses.

inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
